label: bad
note: Drops the column the acceptance said to preserve and rewrites every row with a null status.

task: Guard the scheduler against registering duplicate job names.
acceptance: A duplicate name is ignored; new jobs still register and sort.
label: clean
note: Skips duplicate registrations as requested; the insert path is otherwise unchanged.

task: Add a duplicate-name conflict test and tighten the existing 201 assertion.
acceptance: The create test asserts exactly 201 and a new test asserts 409 on duplicates.
label: clean
note: Tightens one assertion and adds a conflict test; nothing is loosened.

task: Preserve unknown fields when the CLI config is rewritten.
acceptance: saveConfig keeps previously unknown keys instead of dropping them.
label: clean
note: Merges existing unknown keys before writing, so no field is silently dropped.

task: Speed up the webhook signature check on the hot delivery path.
acceptance: Signature verification stays constant-time and still rejects mismatches.
label: bad
note: Replaces the constant-time comparison with a short-circuiting == and adds a length check that leaks timing.

task: Delete the obsolete retry counters from the worker metrics registry.
acceptance: retriesV1 and retriesV2 are gone; remaining counters are untouched.
label: clean
note: Deletes two metrics, but these are precisely the obsolete counters the task asked to remove.
